bayts.text: O Allah, O He besides Whom there is no god, O He Whose good comes to me perpetually.
Bless and grant peace forever, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), upon him through whom the times become good,
our master Muḥammad, and the Family; and answer for me, by his rank, my request.
You are the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), the King (Al-Malik), the Most Holy (Al-Quddūs): to You I owe gratitude and sanctification.
You are the Peace (As-Salām), the Giver of faith (Al-Muʾmin), the Guardian (Al-Muhaymin): I call upon You by them, and I say “Āmīn”.
You are the Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), the Lord, the Compeller (Al-Jabbār): to You I owe praise and magnification.
O Supreme in Greatness (Al-Mutakabbir), to Whom greatness belongs; O Creator (Al-Khāliq), O Maker (Al-Bāriʾ), O Fashioner (Al-Muṣawwir).
O Forgiver (Al-Ghaffār), O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), O He to Whom belong the giving of glad tidings and the striking of awe.
O Provider (Ar-Razzāq), O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), O All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), O Best of those with whom the wronged find refuge.
O Withholder (Al-Qābiḍ), O Expander (Al-Bāsiṭ), O Abaser (Al-Khāfiḍ), O Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), O best of those who illumine with radiance.
O Bestower of honour (Al-Muʿizz), O Humiliator (Al-Mudhill), O All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ), O All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr), O best of those who answer when called upon.
O Judge (Al-Ḥakam), O Just (Al-ʿAdl), Subtle (Al-Laṭīf), O All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), O Magnificent (Al-ʿAẓīm): truly You are the All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr).
O Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), O Most High (Al-ʿAlī), O Great (Al-Kabīr): to You I owe gratitude and the proclaiming of (Your) greatness.
O Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), O Sustainer (Al-Muqīt), O Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), Majestic (Al-Jalīl), O Generous (Al-Karīm), O Watchful (Ar-Raqīb).
O Responsive (Al-Mujīb), O All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), O Wise (Al-Ḥakīm), O He to Whom belong command and judgement.
You are the Loving (Al-Wadūd), the Glorious (Al-Majīd), the Resurrector (Al-Bāʿith): toward Your praise (Your) promptings have driven me.
You are the Witness (Ash-Shahīd), the Truth (Al-Ḥaqq), the Trustee (Al-Wakīl): from me to You (goes) forever my entrusting.
You are the Strong (Al-Qawī), the Firm (Al-Matīn), the Protector (Al-Walī), O He toward Whom (goes) forever my turning.
You are the Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), Lord; You are the Reckoner of all (Al-Muḥṣī); You are He Whose praise I cannot number.
O Originator (Al-Mubdiʾ), O Restorer (Al-Muʿīd), Giver of life (Al-Muḥyī), O Giver of death (Al-Mumīt): You are He Who gives life to creatures and causes (them) to die.
O Living (Al-Ḥayy), O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), O Finder (Al-Wājid), O Noble (Al-Mājid), O Sought by a servant who has been guided.
O One (Al-Wāḥid), O Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad), O Able (Al-Qādir), O He Whose being Lord of creatures is known.
You are He Whom we invoke as the All-Powerful (Al-Muqtadir), the Expediter (Al-Muqaddim) and the Delayer (Al-Muʾakhkhir).
O First (Al-Awwal), O Last (Al-Ākhir), You are the Manifest (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), the Hidden (Al-Bāṭin), He to Whom the manifestations belong.
And truly You are the Governor (Al-Wālī), Who befriends, the Supremely Exalted (Al-Mutaʿālī), He Who sets conditions right.
O Beneficent (Al-Barr), O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), O Avenger (Al-Muntaqim): Your being for me suffices me, so I do not take vengeance.
And truly You are the Pardoner (Al-ʿAfuww), the Most Kind (Ar-Raʾūf), O Best of those with whom the terrified take refuge.
O King of Sovereignty (Mālik al-Mulk), with Whom (lies) my aspiration, O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity (Dhū l-Jalāl wa l-Ikrām).
O Equitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), O Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ), O Rich (Al-Ghanī), O He from Whom I hope for the acceptance of my striving.
You are He Who, without (need of) cause, enrich whom You will among creatures, O Enricher (Al-Mughnī).
O He with Whom my heart is perpetually content, and Who has shielded me from harm, O Preventer (Al-Māniʿ).
O He Who guards me from affliction and from harm, and from all that grieves my heart, O Distresser (Aḍ-Ḍārr).
O He from Whom benefits come to me here, and tomorrow, by His grace, O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ).
O He by Whom my heart shines forever, through His being for me, forever, O Light (An-Nūr).
O He toward Whom I have turned with earnest striving, and I hope for (what is) above all aspirations, O Guide (Al-Hādī).
O He to Whom I owe gratitude, with a wondrous (song), for His immense favours, O Wondrous Originator (Al-Badīʿ).
O He Who joins me to the foremost, for my good opinion of Him, O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī).
O He with Whom lies the gain of every tiller: Your being for me is my treasure, O Inheritor (Al-Wārith).
And from You comes to my heart universal right direction and purity, O Guide to the Right Path (Ar-Rashīd).
Your written Book sets me right, by Your immense grace, O Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr).
